title: Quiet week, Harris County, 2024
description: Real EAGLE-I replay of the quietest fully observed week of 2024 in Harris County, TX: at most 3,131 customers out (0.1713% of customers). The index never reaches theta_lo, so a witness reporting an outage here gets no payout (R5).

data_sources.name: EAGLE-I recorded outages 2024 (eaglei_outages_2024.csv, filtered to TX/FL/IL)

provenance.notes: Real data: EAGLE-I county customers out for FIPS 48201, every 15-minute interval from 2024-11-19T00:00:00Z to 2024-11-26T00:00:00Z (end exclusive). share = customers_out / MCC county customers (1,827,686), capped at 1.0. 0 of 672 intervals have no reading and are points with null values; they are never filled. Off-grid timestamps were moved to the start of their 15-minute slot. Timestamps are UTC (data_quality.json timestamp_check). Selection rule: among 7-day windows starting at 00:00Z in Harris 2024 with every interval present and no dead-feed day, the one with the lowest maximum customers out (earliest on ties). A dead-feed day is a day whose median reading is below 0.1 of the year's median daily median (32.3 customers): 21 days in 2024 (2024-01-08 to 2024-01-08, 2024-04-07 to 2024-04-07, 2024-06-26 to 2024-07-07, 2024-10-02 to 2024-10-08), when the feed reports near zero for a county of 1,827,686 customers. Peak share 0.001713, below theta_lo 0.2.
